english.title: Driver fail to produce insurance certificate - accident - public place
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence, in a public place namely, **(..SPECIFY THE PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..), on being so required by a constable, failed to produce for examination the relevant certificate of insurance under Part VI of the Road Traffic Act 1988
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

english.notes:
(i) For the comparable offence in relation to an accident/offence on a road see H100083.
(ii) This offence wording relates to motor vehicles other than invalid carriages.
(iii) See section 165(2)(c) for requirements re production of goods vehicle plating certificate and test certificate.
(iv) Until 1st November 2021, securities or deposits could be used as an alternative to conventional motor insurance. For offences before that date see H75.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was suspected of being the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) when an accident occurred owing its presence in **(..SPECIFY THE PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..). The defendant failed to produce for examination by a police constable a relevant insurance certificate in respect of the vehicle, when requested to do so, either then or within seven days thereafter.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Gyrrwr wedi methu â chyflwyno tystysgrif yswiriant - damwain - man cyhoeddus
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), a chithau’n unigolyn yr oedd gan swyddog heddlu achos rhesymol dros gredu mai chi oedd gyrrwr cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ar adeg pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb mewn man cyhoeddus, sef **(..SPECIFY THE PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..), ar gais swyddog heddlu, bu ichi fethu â chyflwyno y dystysgrif yswiriant berthnasol ar gyfer ei harchwilio o dan Ran VI Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988
welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts:
Am **(..SPECIFY TIME..) ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) roedd y diffynnydd dan amheuaeth o fod yn yrrwr **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb yn **(..SPECIFY THE PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..).

Methodd y diffynnydd â chyflwyno tystysgrif yswiriant berthnasol ar gyfer y cerbyd i’w harchwilio gan swyddog heddlu ar gais, naill ai ar y pryd neu cyn pen saith diwrnod.
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 165(3) Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988 ac Atodlen 2 i Ddeddf Troseddwyr Traffig Ffyrdd 1988.
